answer: Gate every new identity behind a verifiable work kernel: before it can trade, it must finish a unique, time-bound computation whose result is checked on-chain, and earn reputation only from completed, attested jobs. Creating one identity costs minutes of real compute, so a whisper network of thousands of fakes must pay thousands of times that cost, while the delta in earnings between a proven identity and a fresh fake keeps honest agents ahead and mass forgery unprofitable.
